rows.quote: METHODS: We examined associations between 2922 plasma proteins and blood pressure (BP) traits (systolic BP [SBP] and diastolic BP [DBP], and prevalent hypertension) in 45 991 UK Biobank participants with validation in 5759 FHS (Framingham Heart Study) participants.
rows.coder_note: Reread: row is on the outcome side; sentence names Framingham Heart Study participants as the validation cohort, and no outcome-side dictionary row is for that cohort.

Reread: the abstract describes association analyses in UK Biobank participants and names blood pressure traits as outcomes of a Mendelian randomization, but gives no GWAS release, consortium, year, citation or accession for the outcome data; the participant counts equal no dictionary row N.
